summary: Reverified s1_overall_project_score_integrated_vs_traditional against the complete markdown conversion, including references and the final publisher note, and direct PyMuPDF text from every cited source page (PDF pp. 11, 12, and 20). Also checked PDF pp. 9, 10, 15, 21, and 22 for allocation, arm definitions, analysis counts, and outcome coverage. No appendix is identified. The experimental mean 86.58 and SD 1.84, control mean 79.94 and SD 2.98, t(22) = 6.57, p < 0.001, and Cohen’s d = 2.68 are printed for the overall project-score contrast on PDF p. 20. The 24 observations are projects; contributor counts are not printed for this analysis, so null people counts are appropriate. The five-dimension composite assesses final design-output quality, supporting usefulness and more_creative. Expert raters, output unit and SD level, with_ai, outcome_with_ai=true, immediate timing, null within_person, ai_design (both arms used GenAI), and output-based uncertainty agree with the paper and codebook. The existing notes appropriately retain uncertainty about instructional-cluster replication. The overall score and all five rubric dimensions are represented in the extraction; no additional in-scope outcome or contrast was found. Baseline measures, questionnaire outcomes, SEM paths, interviews, and reliability statistics are appropriately excluded. No problems found in the requested estimate.
